meta.description: Designs and analyzes in vivo CRISPR screens in animal tumor models, organoids, and immune-cell adoptive transfers. Covers bottleneck math, focused library design (Manguso 2017; Chen 2015), CRISPR-StAR intrinsic-control screening (Uijttewaal 2025; worked example from Fenoglio 2026), clonal-dynamics-limited detection, tumor-explant DNA recovery, syngeneic vs xenograft vs PDX, IACUC/ethical requirements, and per-animal MAGeCK hit-calling.

scientific_integrity.detail: All citations remain specific, real, and accurately summarized (Manguso 2017, Chen 2015, Lee 2023, Scheidmann 2022, Uijttewaal 2025). The new CRISPR-StAR worked example's 5 specific numeric claims (30,000 sgRNAs/4 guides per gene/1000x representation; 50,000 cells/uL x 200uL = 10M cells/mouse -> 333x; 75mg/kg tamoxifen x2 days at 150mm3; 28-day harvest; 118 tumors with ~30 sufficient / 7-fold reduction) were independently checked against the actual Fenoglio et al. 2026 Cell Rep Methods 6(7):101470 paper (WebFetch of PMC13390110) and match verbatim -- no fabrication. The Skill also correctly avoids misattributing these numbers to the original 2025 Uijttewaal paper, which does not itself publish them; verified this citation discipline holds under an adversarial prompt (Input 7).

practice_boundaries.detail: Animal-model research-protocol design, not human diagnosis/treatment; no patient-facing medical claims. The new Ethical & Regulatory Requirements section strengthens rather than changes this.

methodological_ground.detail: No statistical fallacy found. The prior audit's finding -- SKILL.md/usage-guide.md never mentioned IACUC/ethical review anywhere despite describing live-animal procedures throughout -- is now fixed: an 'Ethical & Regulatory Requirements' section (IACUC approval, protocol citation, 3Rs) sits immediately after frontmatter in SKILL.md, with a pointer in usage-guide.md's Prerequisites. Re-verified by full-text grep (no longer zero hits) and by re-running the diagnostic input that previously failed this check (Input 5), which now surfaces the requirement when recommending further animal work.

code_usability.detail: mageck test (reused real per-animal output), mageck mle --help (independently re-run against MAGeCK 0.5.9.5, confirmed no --seed flag), and the updated examples/per_animal_meta_analysis.py (independently re-run against the audit's original synthetic data, exit 0, correct output) all execute cleanly. The pre-fix Windows console crash (bare U+2265 in an f-string print()) is gone -- script now runs natively without PYTHONIOENCODING workarounds.

functional_suitability.note: Prior gap (no concrete cell-number/MOI worked example for genome-scale CRISPR-StAR) is closed: worked example added using real, independently-verified published numbers. Full design-to-hit-calling arc remains covered with correct, checkable arithmetic.

reliability.note: Unchanged from prior audit: version-compatibility introspection guidance, quantitative-thresholds and failure-mode tables as built-in sanity checks, correct defensive FileNotFoundError hard-stop in the bundled script.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md grew from ~256 to ~266 lines (ethics section + worked example + determinism note); still reasonably token-efficient for the scope covered. Some duplication between SKILL.md and usage-guide.md's Prerequisites remains (acknowledged, not fixed, in the fix log -- not a stated-fact duplication, so not scored as a defect).

agent_usability.note: Unchanged: clear trigger phrases, 12-step workflow in usage-guide.md, consistent terminology verified across both files.

human_usability.note: Unchanged: Quick Start, Example Prompts, Decision Cheat Sheet, Validation Checklist give strong discoverability and forgiveness.

security.note: Unchanged: no credential handling, no eval/exec of raw strings, no injection surface.

maintainability.note: Unchanged: shipped-means-present check passes (examples/per_animal_meta_analysis.py exists and now runs cleanly, incl. the incidental Windows console-encoding fix). Still only one bundled script, no automated tests.

agent_specific.note: Prior 3-point deduction (fragile compound hit-calling threshold; undocumented MAGeCK MLE non-determinism) is fully resolved and independently re-verified: the threshold now recovers 4/5 planted hits with 0 false positives instead of 0/5, and the MLE determinism note is confirmed accurate against mageck mle --help.

key_strengths: The compound hit-calling threshold, the audit's headline P1 finding, is fixed and independently re-verified against the original synthetic data: recovers 4/5 planted hits with 0 false positives (vs. 0/5 pre-fix), with the 5th correctly surfaced for manual review rather than silently dropped.

The new CRISPR-StAR worked example's 5 specific numeric claims were independently checked against the actual cited paper's full text (Fenoglio et al. 2026, PMC13390110) and match verbatim -- a genuine, verified citation, not a claim taken on trust.
The Skill correctly maintains citation discipline under adversarial pressure: an input designed to elicit misattribution of the 2026 paper's numbers to the 2025 paper was correctly resisted.
The MAGeCK MLE determinism note is independently confirmed accurate (mageck mle --help, MAGeCK 0.5.9.5, genuinely has no --seed flag) and gives a correct, actionable stable-metric recommendation.
The incidental Windows console-encoding bug in the bundled example script is fixed and verified to run natively without an environment workaround.

recommendations.title: Ethics-requirement surfacing relies on agent judgment, not a forced trigger
recommendations.problem: The new Ethical & Regulatory Requirements section is a standing, prominent note but is not explicitly tied to the points in the Skill where new animal work is recommended (e.g., 'arrayed validation of top hits', 'increase animals per condition'). Passing Input 5 required the agent to connect the two on its own rather than being prompted to.
recommendations.root_cause: The fix added a standing compliance section but did not cross-reference it from the specific workflow steps (Validation Checklist, arrayed-validation guidance) that recommend new live-animal procedures.
recommendations.fix: Add a one-line pointer back to the Ethical & Regulatory Requirements section at the points in usage-guide.md's 'What the Agent Will Do' and Validation Checklist where new animal cohorts or procedures are recommended, so the reminder is structurally guaranteed rather than judgment-dependent.
